text:
Mario, ungrateful love as witness
        to my pure faith and great steadfastness,
        showing in me its vile nature,
        which is to do greater wrong to the closest friend;


        fearing that if I write or speak
        of its nature, I diminish its greatness,
        its strength not sufficing for my harshness,
        it has strengthened the hand of my enemy.


        And so, in the part the right hand
        commands, and in that which declares
        the soul's conception, I was wounded.


        Yet I shall make this offense cost dearly
        to the offender, for now I am healed,
        free, desperate, and offended.

translation.title: Mario, ungrateful love as witness
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
